name: Davriel Cane
description: A planeswalker who enjoys wealth, luxury and fine tea and is a talented diabolist skilled at binding demons to his service.

description_citations.text: "Davriel Cane". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Davriel often finds himself in the hero's role despite detesting it and trying to avoid it.
timeline.quote: He detests playing the hero, yet often finds himself in the role despite his best efforts to avoid it.
